name: udp_egress_handler
description: Boundary gateway consuming MessageEnvelope frames from internal pipeline channels, reading client provenance, and transmitting UDP datagrams outwards.

inputs.name: input_channel
inputs.label: Pipeline Ingress
inputs.description: Internal pipeline channel delivering messages destined for egress.

egress.mode.label: Transmission Mode
egress.mode.description: Controls whether responses are sent to the originating client socket or a fixed destination host/port.

egress.dest_host.label: Destination Host
egress.dest_host.description: Target IPv4/IPv6 address when mode is fixed_destination.

egress.dest_port.label: Destination Port
egress.dest_port.description: Target UDP port when mode is fixed_destination.
